assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced proximity degradation turned a biological process, ubiquitin-proteasome turnover, into a designable chemical reaction. It gave biologists a general tool to remove proteins, and it gave medicine a new drug modality. Mechanistically well defined and broad.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies established the heterobifunctional PROTAC concept and its first demonstrations. Handa and colleagues identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, which underlies the molecular glue arm. Ciulli, Gray and others made major later contributions, so a three-person cut is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Independent confirmation is extensive across many labs, and clinical degraders are in late-stage trials. Timing is good, though full clinical validation is still pending.
uncertainties: Whether the prize would split PROTACs from molecular glues, and who is credited for each
Clinical outcomes of degraders are not yet settled
My recollection of the contribution order is from memory and unverified

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Sequencing-by-synthesis with reversible terminator nucleotides is a chemical invention that made genomes cheap to read, which transformed genome-stability, mutation and cancer research. Its impact is very large and has lasted.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman are the core Solexa chemistry and single-molecule inventors. Mayer's cluster amplification idea was also decisive. Rothberg, Ju and others are credited for parallel platforms, so allocation among platforms is unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Fully mature, with two decades of independent use. Recognition is arguably overdue.
uncertainties: Competing platform credit (454, Illumina, Ion Torrent) complicates a fair three-person split
Whether the committee sees this as chemistry rather than technology

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Orthogonal aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase/tRNA pairs let cells incorporate nonnatural amino acids, so protein chemistry can be installed in living systems. It is original, general and widely used as a tool by biologists.
assessment.attribution: Schultz and Wang created the first in vivo systems in E. coli and yeast. Chin extended the code to eukaryotes and multiple codons. Mehl and Yokoyama also made direct contributions.
assessment.maturity: Replicated widely and mature, including therapeutic protein applications. Timing is appropriate.
uncertainties: Overlap with earlier recognition for directed evolution and chemical biology
Credit among Schultz-trained coauthors is fine-grained and unresolved

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Structural and mechanistic work on the FeMo cofactor showed how biology reduces N2 to NH3, a core biological chemistry question. Interstitial carbide and states of the active site were resolved crystallographically and spectroscopically.
assessment.attribution: Rees and Einsle led the crystallography, including the carbide. Seefeldt and Dean contributed mechanism and genetics, and Ribbe the cofactor biosynthesis. The credited set is plausible but not clean.
assessment.maturity: Structures are independently confirmed, but the catalytic mechanism and the substrate-binding states remain debated, so the story is incomplete.
uncertainties: The mechanism of N2 binding and reduction is unsettled
Which laureates to pick among structure, mechanism and genetics groups

assessment.nobel_worthiness: In vitro selection (SELEX) made evolution a laboratory chemistry for nucleic acids, yielding aptamers and ribozymes. It is a general method that other fields use.
assessment.attribution: Tuerk and Gold and Ellington and Szostak reported the foundational selections in 1990. Joyce is also credited. Szostak is already a laureate in Medicine, which complicates but does not exclude him.
assessment.maturity: Mature and widely reproduced. Therapeutic aptamers have limited impact, which tempers significance.
uncertainties: Prior recognition of directed evolution and ribozymes overlaps

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantitative proteomics allows measuring protein and modification levels globally, much like the quantitative measurement I value in nucleotide pool work. Its impact on cell biology and medicine is extensive.
assessment.attribution: Mann, Aebersold and Yates each built distinct, decisive strategies (shotgun, targeted and quantitative methods). Hunt, Gygi and Heck are also strong, so the cutoff is difficult.
assessment.maturity: Mature with extensive independent use. A 2002 prize already recognised the ionization methods.
uncertainties: Overlap with the earlier ionization prize
Who to omit among six or more credited names

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Activity-based probes turn enzyme activity into a chemically measurable readout in complex proteomes, and they enabled covalent ligand discovery. It is a tool for biologists with clear chemical logic.
assessment.attribution: Cravatt is the central figure for activity-based protein profiling. Bogyo and Overkleeft developed complementary probe classes, and the credit among them is plausible but not settled.
assessment.maturity: Established, with clinical and chemoproteomic follow-ups still developing. Possibly slightly early for a full prize.
uncertainties: Overlap with covalent drug discovery candidates
Whether the field is judged to be a method or a discovery

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Native chemical ligation made total synthesis and semisynthesis of proteins routine, which opened protein chemistry to precise modification. It is a clean chemical reaction with biological reach.
assessment.attribution: Kent and Dawson introduced native chemical ligation in 1994 and Muir developed expressed protein ligation. Danishefsky, Brik and Liu are also credited for later extensions.
assessment.maturity: Mature and reproduced widely, though applications beyond small proteins remain limited. Recognition is timely.
uncertainties: Importance relative to genetic-code expansion and other protein tools
